section.3: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah

3.name_native: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah concerning Asma' bint Umais that when she gave birth at Dhul-Hulaifah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Abu Bakr:"Tell her to perform Ghusl and (begin the Talbiyah)
